modules.bfv_generic: plain Lattigo BFV wrapper (baseline, no verification)

content.note: REP = replication encoding (vche_1); PE = polynomial encoding (vche_2). Optimized variants are the *_CFPRF modules. Dependencies isolated under external/; system Go and /usr/local untouched.

bfv_profile_candidate.note: VERITAS vche_1/vche_2 benchmarks use PN14QP438. t=65537 must satisfy BFV batching (2N | t-1): 2*16384=32768 divides 65536. Verified candidate common profile; final profile confirmed in G2/G5.

build_status.g7_128_strategy: Single comparison group PN14: n<=64 single ciphertext, n=128 tiled (T=64) reusing the verified PublicRightMatmul kernel + ct-ct adds. bfvpack.PlanMatmul is a deterministic planner (plan_test.go); tiled_test.go round-trips 8^3, 130x128, 128x128, rectangular, sub-tile. PN15QP880 (N=32768, t=65537, 2N|t-1) validated as single-ciphertext alternative for bfv_only/sketch 128 (TestSingleCtPN15_128); DataSeal 128 (130^2=16900 > PN15 half 16384) has no single-ciphertext layout in the registry. PN16 intentionally excluded.
build_status.g8_veritas_authenticated_matmul: REP (vche_1) and PE (vche_2) public-right matmul C=A*B (A confidential, B public) implemented from official authenticated RotateColumns + Mul(ct, tagged PlaintextMul) + Add, verified via official DecodeUint. veritas/matmul_test.go confirms exact F_p result, official-verifier acceptance, and rejection on ciphertext/tag mismatch for sizes up to NSlots/2 (REP PN13 numReplications=4 -> dim<=32; PE PN13 -> dim<=64). Upgrades the prior METHOD_MISMATCH to PASS for supported sizes. REP/PE run at PN13 native params: PARAMETER_MISMATCH vs the PN14 BFV group (no absolute-time comparison). Composition (A*B1+D)*B2 remains METHOD_MISMATCH (not implemented).
build_status.g9_finding_checksum_tiling_overhead: Corrects the earlier 'checksum overhead ~ 0' claim: it holds only while the checksum fits the same single ciphertext. Under 128 tiling the two DataSeal checksum rows add a third block row, raising tile multiplies 8->12 and measured server time ~9.7s -> ~14.5s (~1.5x). Raw: results/lattigo/final/matmul_sweep.json.
build_status.lattigo_bfv: downloads pinned version and builds/runs (BFV smoke works)
build_status.own_go_module: builds and runs (go test on self-written module passes)
build_status.veritas_pe_vche_2: builds and runs; matched add/square integrated and verified in G3
build_status.veritas_rep_vche_1: builds and runs; benchmarks run (Add 0.12ms, Mul deg1 11.3ms, Relin 5.9ms at N=16384). Upstream TestVCHE1 fails the Type2Fails negative subtests (Add/Sub/Rotate...) ONLY at the LogN=16 / NumReplications=1 (PN16) parameter set. VERIFIED this is NOT a Go-toolchain artifact: it reproduces identically under Go 1.16 (earliest arm64 toolchain, contemporaneous with the module's go 1.15 directive). Cause is structural: at NumReplications=1 there is no replication redundancy, so verifyUint cannot detect a consistently-manipulated ciphertext. Smaller sets (NumReplications=64) pass these negative tests.

lattigo.note: The replace directive lives in the VERITAS module. A separate main module must re-declare the same replace at main-module level; the experiments/lattigo go.mod does so.
